articles.title: Slow-Moving Nor'easter Floods the Northeast, Cutting Power to 100,000
articles.summary: A slow, powerful nor'easter is drenching the northeast U.S. this weekend, knocking out power to about 100,000 customers. A Jersey Shore marina owner says water is inside his building for the first time since Hurricane Sandy.

articles.title: Pope Leo XIV Draws 700,000 to Paris Mass, Calls Young People 'Today's Church'
articles.summary: Pope Leo XIV celebrated an open-air Mass in Paris on Saturday, drawing an estimated 700,000 people. He praised young people's 'enthusiasm, energy and commitment' and called them 'today's Church.'

articles.title: Trump Uses Rare 'Pocket Rescission' to Cut $1 Billion Congress Already Approved
articles.summary: President Trump is canceling nearly $1 billion in spending Congress approved — for refugee services, migrant students, and minority businesses. A Republican senator calls it illegal. The Government Accountability Office agrees. The fight is heading to court.
